title: Definitions Entry — The Stretch the Return History Is Read Over on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

# Definitions Entry — The Stretch the Return History Is Read Over on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

**The stretch the return history is read over** on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan is the run of whole calendar months across which payments the bank has sent back unpaid are counted.

- Where the plan stands past due at the handling date, the returns are counted over the **12** whole calendar months ending on the handling date.
- Where the plan has been billing for fewer whole calendar months than the term's repeat window, the returns are counted over every whole calendar month since the plan began billing.
- In every other case, the returns are counted over the term's repeat window of whole calendar months ending on the handling date.

The first condition governs first: a past due plan reads 12 whole calendar months even where it has been billing for fewer months than the term's repeat window.

## The repeat window by term

| Term | 6-Month Deferred Interest | 12-Month Deferred Interest | 18-Month Deferred Interest | 24-Month Equal Payment | 36-Month Equal Payment | 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Repeat window, rolling whole months | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |

The repeat window stands at 6 whole calendar months on every promotional term.

## Worked readings (hypothetical)

| The plan | The stretch |
|---|---|
| Standing past due, billing for 3 whole calendar months | 12 whole calendar months ending on the handling date |
| Standing active, billing for 3 whole calendar months | Every whole calendar month since the plan began billing, that is 3 |
| Standing active, billing for 20 whole calendar months | The term's repeat window, 6 whole calendar months ending on the handling date |
